reviewed_phase_contexts.schedule_instance_semantics:
Each CTA copies execution-time m_indptr and builds prefix once.
For each assigned w it searches from group zero, skipping empty
groups, and recovers (g,x,y). Workers with worker_id>=W initialize
Schedule but execute no worktiles. Each actual submission has new
worker-local state. Repeated calls execute again even on a wrapper
memo hit; tensor contents are never memoized. Recorded execution
retains its host-bound parameters and reads current device contents.

The two launches use the same request stream. first.kernel_done includes
all first-grid output writes and worker teardown before retry begins;
it does not require a blocking host wait. The grids have distinct worker
and local-resource instances even if their mappings are identical.
There is no cross-phase data handoff: retry reads the original inputs,
reinitializes its local accumulators and overwrites out without reading
first's output. The graph for either phase retains its own ParamsW and
tensor maps, including its recorded bstream flag; a direct submission
uses the current parameters. The grid and activation-map availability
also belong to that submission.

on the host. Reduced-height map failure only disables H reduction.
An attempt with no actual computation adds no entry to L; the selection
here requires both actual compute submissions. Subsequent API errors
do not retract them. Model.forward propagates a nonzero return code
without switching to the sync engine.

on the host. Reduced-height map failure only disables H reduction.
An attempt with no actual computation adds no entry to L; the selection
here requires all four actual compute submissions. Subsequent API errors
do not retract them. Model.forward propagates a nonzero return code
without switching to the sync engine.

math_steps.name: Block scaling and ordered output accumulation

reviewed_phase_contexts.schedule_binding:
Bind q=0 in first (G graph), q=1 in retry (direct G), q=2 in
fallback (F graph) and q=3 in final (direct F). Use L[q] and
that actual submission's by-value parameters and tensor maps. Tensor
bindings and host choices in a graph come from recording or explicit
updates; reads of tensor contents occur during this execution.
Bm = 128 and Bn = 256. Let prefix(0)=0 and
prefix(g+1)=prefix(g)+Tm(g); W=prefix(E)*Tn.
The work numbered w has the unique nonempty group g satisfying
prefix(g)*Tn <= w < prefix(g+1)*Tn.
Let z=w-prefix(g)*Tn; y=floor(z/Tm(g)), x=z%Tm(g).
This binds the mathematical worktile (q,g,x,y), including r0,c0,V.
The activation extent H is the smallest member of {16,32,64,128}
at least V when all three reduced-height tensor maps were obtained;
otherwise H=128 for this submission. Only H rows are loaded, but
every block product evaluates Bm rows as defined in block_dot.
Each local iteration consumes block kb, kb in [0,KB).
All scales and all K contributions are applied inside this worktile;
no cross-worktile reduction or intermediate global matrix is used.
reviewed_phase_contexts.schedule_instance_semantics:
Each CTA independently copies the execution-time m_indptr and builds
prefix once. Producer and epilogue scan groups monotonically from
their previous group for each increasing assigned w. Empty groups
are skipped. Workers with worker_id >= W do initialization and
teardown but execute no worktile.
All four launches use the same request stream. Each predecessor's
kernel_done includes its output writes and worker teardown before
the next grid begins; no blocking host wait is required. Each grid
has distinct worker and local-resource instances even if mappings match.
There is no cross-phase data handoff: every phase reads the original
inputs, reinitializes its local accumulators and overwrites out without
reading a prior phase's output. A graph retains its own ParamsW and
tensor maps, including its recorded bstream flag; a direct submission
uses the current parameters. The grid and activation-map availability
also belong to that submission.
Required A, output and wide B maps and shared-memory capacity are checked
on the host. Reduced-height map failure only disables H reduction.
An attempt with no actual computation adds no entry to L; the selection
here requires all four actual compute submissions. Subsequent API errors
do not retract them. Model.forward propagates a nonzero return code
without switching to the sync engine.

findings.title: 声明、alias 展开与完整覆盖
findings.observation: 7个 approved 有稿节点的 pipeline 均本地定义；A为19 role/51块/140静态动作，B=C为40 role/107块/289静态动作，root为3/8/23。四个 recovery 节点复用整 phase；展开增加56块和149个静态动作出现，不是再次创作。6个精确组覆盖全部40个role上下文。
findings.semantic_role: A保留源声明规模，B/C保留每个phase使用位置；源节点身份与alias坐标帮助区分一次声明和多个独立提交中的使用。
findings.uncertainty: B/C未展开运行时repeat；group指纹不含domain、info或waits_for。alias证据的line为声明行，其使用坐标另见reviewed_role_contexts.occurrence_line/block_locations。

findings.title: 本地工作序号、连续归约序号与循环布局
findings.observation: t为worker本地worktile序号，数学group g由work_schedule解码。root/v0将(t,q) flatten为n，q是K块对；wide将(t,kb) flatten为n，kb是单块。Producer/Issuer重复n，Epilogue重复t后进入n[t]；sync在t内重复kb。全部107块带repeat，67个子块都是repeat+steady，最深3层；无prologue/epilogue内嵌循环；27个混排列表、13个列表中的36对相邻循环。
findings.semantic_role: 连续n把输入环、产品环和移位依赖接到下一worktile；t分界保留每份输出的初始化与写回。n[t]提供当前工作的归约切片，group解码不额外形成pipe循环。
findings.uncertainty: repeat_binding_flags为非互斥的语法线索；计数不等于循环实际执行次数。不存在独立g循环。

findings.title: 同一精确pipe随参数、宽度与成员契约改变含义
findings.observation: Producer精确组共有13个上下文及5份不同role契约：pair每次装两个K块、输入环深3；wide装单块，J=1(F)/2(G)，R=5-J，输入环深4/3。同形wide Epilogue的完整块批数为2/J、staging宽J*ScaleN。pair Issuer的NI为1或2，成员参与由提交标量决定；pair Epilogue分行，wide两个四-warp组分列后再分行。H只改变载入行范围，全部Bm行仍计算并参与归还。
findings.semantic_role: pipe只写共同顺序，动作契约绑定载荷、参与者与组合完成范围，资源字段承接容量，调度和提交绑定给出本次实例的J/R/H/NI。
findings.uncertainty: 一个phase只有一个Epilogue role；warp分工不能计成额外role。Hoist未出现在本批7节点。

findings.title: 分片流水的显式开头、稳态与结尾位置
findings.observation: 13个Epilogue上下文先read第0片，内部d切片重复await当前片、read下一片、compute当前片；pair切片为d[0:7]，wide为d[0:3]。最后一次await之后release产品，再做最终compute。await的显式前驱接到done；role为serial，read单独为async。
findings.semantic_role: 预读下一片与当前寄存器累加的相对次序由列表给定；所有TMEM读取完成后即可归还产品槽，最后寄存器FMA继续。正文限定所有行及wide的两个列组都必须完成读取，不能把单片或单成员完成当作整个槽的归还。
findings.uncertainty: 静态文本与冻结语义核对；未进行事件展开或 GPU 验证。

findings.title: f/z域选择写回路径并限定staging等待位置
findings.observation: pair的f域为[0,Full(t))，wide为[0,Full(t)*2/J)，z域均为[0,1-Full(t))。full执行release:Staging、publish、async store；tail只直接写有效行。release等所有先前bulk store结束源读取，包含此前worktile及当前worktile早期批次；tail保留该历史。首次full没有旧store可等但release动作仍存在。
findings.semantic_role: 空局部域控制动作是否存在；f块内的release把等待定位在staging覆盖之前，允许先前目的写仍在途。最外层drain最终等待所有目的写完成。f在wide F实例有两个值，不能把所有局部域都称为0/1门控。
findings.uncertainty: 本批不存在局部q可选等待或Hoist；不能把历史文档示例算作该算子的语法出现。等待全部在途store的集合由原语契约描述，没有从pipe中的显式waits_for枚举推导运行时集合。

findings.title: 预取中的空操作事件与空域不同
findings.observation: pair Epilogue每worktile预取两个activation scale组，稳态用q+2补入；最终两组为空commit但仍有事件，copy流不在worktile边界显式drain/reset。wide的RawScale在p>=KB时给零、不作全局读且issue时完成。sync的Stage在p>=KB时也有空提交，drain显式等待KB与KB+1。
findings.semantic_role: 首部预取和稳态补入保持固定窗口；契约区分无载荷动作与不存在动作。已捕获的当前scale在预取寄存器被覆盖后继续用于本轮计算，使scale预取能够位于产品acquire之前。
findings.uncertainty: 空copy group仍有issue/done；没有将无数据动作删除，也没有从静态动作数估计传输工作量。

findings.title: 一次性初始化、每工作初值与最终退役各有位置
findings.observation: Producer prologue中的initialize是async role的serial例外，完成CTA入口汇合及资源初始化；Epilogue prologue通过wait:Schedule@done接到它。每t的prepare初始化F。UMMA的外层epilogue执行drain:Stores；最终所有role完成后CTA汇合与ProductRing退役写在drain正文中。空worker仍执行首尾。sync把drain放在每t内，之后才能把InputRing同一槽转作Output，store.done的CTA汇合保护下一t。
findings.semantic_role: 嵌套位置区分worker生命周期和worktile生命周期；上游数学给出F初值，正文把初始化归入prepare。显式顺序与动作完成契约共同约束共享存储用途切换、源读结束和资源退役。
findings.uncertainty: 未把正文中的最终CTA汇合/退役补算成pipe里的新动作种类；结构未单列这些动作不等于正文没有保证。

findings.title: phase复用保持独立提交与索引身份
findings.observation: v0_recovery的graph/direct分别绑定数学评估r=0/1；wide_recovery系列按各phase绑定提交q，分别2/3/4次实际计算。flow用前一kernel_done连接后一次。wide_recovery_full绑定G graph、direct G、F graph、direct F，同一pipe的J/R由各次L[q]决定。每次新建worker和局部状态，重读原输入并完整覆盖out，无前次输出作为handoff输入。
findings.semantic_role: alias节省源声明但不共享事件实例。math、schedule与dispatch绑定确定每个使用位置的归约结果、图录制参数或直接提交参数；kernel_done同时覆盖前次写回和退役，建立完整提交顺序。
findings.uncertainty: wide recovery的提交q与root/v0的局部K-pair q不在同一节点域中，不判为命名冲突。描述的是被节点选择的实际提交记录，不证明所有错误链可达或成功。

findings.title: 已有源实现偏差限定审计结论
findings.observation: root、v0_recovery及四个wide节点的thesis已注明源TMEM drain遗漏行组/行块地址贡献；稿件保留完整产品和独立行所有权。当前文件无单独的语法构造表达该实现偏差。
findings.semantic_role: 来源注记划定文本所表达的设计与源实现证据边界，避免把完成事件和完整行协作的文本保证当作实际kernel正确性的证明。
findings.uncertainty: 本轮未执行源码/GPU或展开ISA lane规则；该偏差来自冻结稿已有来源说明，不作为新发现的语言缺口或新语法类型。
